page_title: VEN 0-0 LAZ | Venezia v Lazio 22/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Matteo Marchetti is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+4' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) goes into the book for a horrible tackle. A yellow card is necessary in this case.
90+3' Cheick Conde (Venezia) aims for the middle of the goal, but that's an easy job for the goalkeeper. It will take more than that to test him!
90+2' Cheick Conde (Venezia) has tested the patience of referee Matteo Marchetti and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
90+1' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90+1' Venezia have been awarded a corner kick.
90' Alessio Zerbin (Venezia) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
89' John Yeboah (Venezia) beats the defender to the ball in the box and shoots, but the ball flashes high over the bar.

88' Alessio Zerbin (Venezia) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net.
87' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Cheick Conde (Venezia) replaces Hans Nicolussi Caviglia.
86' Mario Gila (Lazio) heads the ball towards goal, but his effort is saved by the goalkeeper.
86' Matteo Marchetti shows a yellow card to Joel Schingtienne (Venezia) for his blatant foul.
84' Marco Baroni has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Loum Tchaouna (Lazio) replacing Boulaye Dia.
83' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Venezia) makes a rough challenge and Matteo Marchetti blows his whistle for a foul.
81' Alessio Zerbin (Venezia) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
79' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
78' Mikael Egill Ellertsson (Venezia) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
78' Alessio Zerbin (Venezia) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
77' Substitution. Mirko Maric makes way for Daniel Fila (Venezia).
76' Eusebio Di Francesco has decided to make a change. Gianluca Busio (Venezia) replaces Issa Doumbia.
76' Substitution. John Yeboah (Venezia) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Gaetano Oristanio walks off.
75' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Venezia) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
74' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Kike Perez (Venezia) takes it short.

74' Gaetano Oristanio (Venezia) wasted a huge opportunity! The fans already began to celebrate as he produced a shot from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort. The ball went towards the bottom right corner, but Christos Mandas made an astonishing save!
73' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
72' A pass by Pedro (Lazio) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
70' Kike Perez (Venezia) sends over a poor, overhit cross from the corner kick and the ball goes out of play.
69' Alessio Zerbin (Venezia) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety.
68' Joel Schingtienne (Venezia) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Matteo Marchetti blows his whistle for a foul.
67' Venezia will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
67' An attempted cross from Gaetano Oristanio (Venezia) is cleared.
65' The free kick is whipped into the box and finds Mirko Maric (Venezia), who plants a header just wide of the right post from close range.
63' Mirko Maric (Venezia) beats the defender inside the box and lashes a shot towards the bottom right corner, but Christos Mandas makes a brilliant reflex save to deny him. Goalkeeping at its best!
61' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
60' Mirko Maric (Venezia) climbs high to connect with a cross near the penalty spot but plants a header well wide of the left post.
58' Lazio have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
56' Nuno Tavares comes off the pitch to be replaced by Manuel Lazzari (Lazio).
56' Marco Baroni decides to make a substitution. Tijjani Noslin will be replaced by Pedro (Lazio).
55' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Alessandro Marcandalli trots off the pitch and is replaced by Joel Schingtienne (Venezia).
54' The referee signals a corner kick to Lazio.
54' A cross from Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
54' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) takes the corner with a short pass.
53' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Lazio comes to nothing.
53' A dangerous attempt from Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) was aimed towards the roof of the net, but Ionut Radu pulls off a superb save and stops this one.
51' Kike Perez (Venezia) takes the corner, but the goalkeeper jumps and gathers the ball.
51' Gaetano Oristanio (Venezia) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear.
49' Mikael Egill Ellertsson (Venezia) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
47' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) was quite harsh and Matteo Marchetti didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
47' Alessio Romagnoli (Lazio) shows too much aggression while trying to break free from his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) manages to beat his opponent to the ball, but he commits a foul in the process.
45+2' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
45' A free kick from far out for Lazio. We are about to see the outcome very soon.
45' Gaetano Oristanio (Venezia) makes a strong challenge and Matteo Marchetti blows for a foul.

43' Lazio slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
40' Fisayo Dele-Bashiru is being substituted because of an injury. Marco Baroni sends Reda Belahyane (Lazio) on the pitch.
39' Fisayo Dele-Bashiru (Lazio) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
38' The keeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Fisayo Dele-Bashiru (Lazio) sacrificed accuracy for power, and thus his attempt went well wide of the right post.
36' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Lazio.
36' Tijjani Noslin (Lazio) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
35' Boulaye Dia (Lazio) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
32' Alessio Zerbin (Venezia) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.

32' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Venezia are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
29' Kike Perez (Venezia) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety.
28' Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) brings down his opponent with a very late tackle.
27' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Venezia) was too forceful with his tackle and Matteo Marchetti interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
23' Boulaye Dia (Lazio) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. He sends the ball into orbit.
22' Venezia concede a free kick following a bad challenge.
20' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Venezia) sends a long ball in, but Christos Mandas comfortably gathers the ball.
19' Gaetano Oristanio (Venezia) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
16' Alessio Romagnoli (Lazio) swings the ball into the box from the corner kick but it's a bit too strong and it goes out of play.
14' Boulaye Dia (Lazio) has an effort from the edge of the area, but he skies the ball over the top.
14' Issa Doumbia (Venezia) got the ball on the edge of the box and produced a strong shot, but one of his teammates was standing in the wrong place and unintentionally blocked the effort.
14' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Ionut Radu, who smothers the ball.

12' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot low towards the middle of the goal, but Ionut Radu pulls off a comfortable save.
11' Mirko Maric (Venezia) runs onto the ball and hits a thunderbolt of a shot at goal from the edge of the box, but sends it narrowly wide of the right post.
9' Jay Idzes (Venezia) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
7' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Alessandro Marcandalli (Venezia) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
6' Matteo Marchetti blows his whistle for a foul after Alessandro Marcandalli (Venezia) hacks down one of his opponents.
6' Mirko Maric (Venezia) and Gaetano Oristanio try to prise open the opposition with a series of short passes, but one of the defenders steps in and puts an end to the move.
3' Gaetano Oristanio (Venezia) and Alessio Zerbin attempt to exchange short two-yard passes, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
2' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Gaetano Oristanio (Venezia).
1' A corner kick by Venezia is thwarted by the well prepared Christos Mandas (Lazio).
1' The first half has started.
Venezia will kick the game off.
Matteo Marchetti will officiate today.
